source: Original procedural synthesis using damped resonators and a plucked-string modal model.

layers.shuttle: Frame contact and guide chatter at 0, 4, 8.5 and 14 ms
layers.filament: 236 Hz strand, 18 damped partials, released at 11.5 ms
layers.tines: Paired 884 and 891 Hz resonances with two short upper modes
layers.detent: Bobbin catch at 130 ms, housing rebound at 139 ms
